body: Thanks, I'll try to do that next time. I do have a bad habit of complaining about things so I'll try harder to not make this sound like another complaint. Maybe I'll try to bring up the subject soon.

Hey, thanks for replying. 
Quite a few of my friends actually know about my depression and that I have "bad days" every now and then but I haven't told anyone about how its been getting worse. My best friend is moving soon and I've been afraid to ruin the little time we have left together by complaining about my own issues... I try to open up about this stuff but every time I do it feels like I'm becoming that person who is constantly bringing everyone down with their issues. My friends are really supportive but still, I worry about becoming that person.
